# opnsense_dnsmasq_domain (Resource)

Dnsmasq domain overrides (Services > Dnsmasq DNS & DHCP > Domains): send queries for a domain to a specific DNS server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Resolve the corporate domain through the VPN's DNS server.
resource "opnsense_dnsmasq_domain" "corp" {
  domain      = "corp.example.com"
  server      = "10.20.0.53"
  description = "Corporate DNS over the site-to-site VPN"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain to override, e.g. `corp.example.com`.
- `server` (String) DNS server to send the domain's queries to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to `""`.
- `firewall_alias` (String) Firewall alias (by name) to add the domain's resolved addresses to. Defaults to `""`.
- `port` (String) DNS server port; empty uses 53. Defaults to `""`.
- `sequence` (Number) Order of the entry in the generated configuration. Defaults to `1`.
- `source_ip` (String) Source address for queries to the server. Defaults to `""`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the override.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import opnsense_dnsmasq_domain.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
